data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC, ETH and XRP pause as momentum indicators signal overbought conditions, massive rallies | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) hover around key levels on Monday, with a bullish bias but appearing stretched after surging over 23%, 31% and 53% in the previous week.
